en: Hi Vanity Fair, I'm Charles Leclerc.
zh: 嗨，Vanity Fair，我是Charles Leclerc。

en: and I'm getting ready for the Cannes Festival, come on in.
zh: 我正在为Cannes Festival做准备，进来吧。

en: Today we are in Cannes for the Festival de Cannes.
zh: 今天我们在戛纳，参加Festival de Cannes。

en: and I'm getting ready for the red carpet tonight.
zh: 我正在为今晚的红毯做准备。

en: It's not my first time in Cannes but it's my first time here for the Festival de Cannes.
zh: 这不是我第一次来戛纳，但这是我第一次为了Festival de Cannes来到这里。

en: Growing up in Monaco it's a huge event worldwide.
zh: 我从小在摩纳哥🇲🇨长大，所以知道这是全球瞩目的大活动。

en: I'm really excited, I mean it's a very new experience to me,
zh: 我真的很兴奋，毕竟这对我来说是一次非常新鲜的体验，

en: a lot to discover.
zh: 有很多东西可以去发现。

en: I'm here with my wife Alexandra as well.
zh: 我这次也和我的妻子Alexandra一起来了。

en: she did the red carpet last year.
zh: 她去年走过红毯。

en: I'm looking forward to it, I don't really know what to expect.
zh: 我很期待，不过说实话，我也不太知道会发生什么。

en: I did one premiere not in Festival de Cannes again but for the F1 movie.
zh: 我之前参加过一次首映礼，不是在Festival de Cannes，而是F1电影的首映。

en: It's a fully new world, I mean I love watching movies.
zh: 这是一个全新的世界，我是说，我很喜欢看电影。

en: I don't know much about this world actually.
zh: 但其实我对这个领域了解不多。

en: The world of Formula One is quite unique but I'm sure that the world of movies.
zh: F1的世界非常独特，但我相信电影的世界。

en: and others are always super interesting and I'm very curious.
zh: 以及其他领域，也一定都非常有意思，我也很好奇。

en: so I'm looking forward to that.
zh: 所以我很期待。

en: Mentally there's some tension because I mean I go a little bit into the unknown.
zh: 心理上还是会有一点紧张，因为我算是走进了一个未知的领域。

en: I don't think there's a special mental preparation, it's just a bit out of my comfort zone but I'm looking forward to that.
zh: 我觉得没有什么特别的心理准备，只是有点走出舒适区，但我很期待。

en: The thing is that I'm always on the road, always on races,
zh: 问题是我总是在路上，总是在参加比赛，

en: always on racing tracks.
zh: 总是在赛道上。

en: So not much time for free time.
zh: 所以没有太多空闲时间。

en: and the little free time I have I spend it with my family,
zh: 而我仅有的一点空闲时间，都会用来陪家人，

en: with my dog Leo that I miss today in Cannes actually.
zh: 还有陪我的狗Leo，说实话今天在戛纳我还挺想它的。

en: Leo travels with us nearly everywhere, he's a superstar.
zh: Leo几乎会跟我们一起去任何地方，它可是个大明星。

en: I'm sure he could be invited to the Cannes Festival one day.
zh: 我相信有一天它也能被邀请来Cannes Festival。

en: Has there ever been a dog walking the red carpet in Cannes Festival?
zh: Cannes Festival以前有狗走过红毯吗？

en: Maybe he could be the first dog to walk the red carpet.
zh: 也许它可以成为第一只走上红毯的狗。

en: Oh my god, I would love that.
zh: 天啊，我真的会很喜欢那样。

en: I mean I don't even know what the red carpet looks like but
zh: 我是说，我甚至都不知道红毯到底长什么样，但

en: if it's a big red carpet.
zh: 如果那是一条很大的红毯。

en: I'll bring a toy, he will have the time of his life.
zh: 我就带个玩具来，它一定会玩得特别开心。

en: The look tonight is actually a Giorgio Armani look, it's a suit.
zh: 今晚的造型其实是Giorgio Armani的，是一套西装。

en: I just need to feel myself whenever I wear something that's where I feel the best and that's
zh: 每次穿一件衣服，我只需要感觉像我自己，那就是我状态最好的时候，也就是

en: where it looks most authentic.
zh: 看起来最真实自然的时候。

en: and authenticity is important for me.
zh: 而真实感对我来说很重要。

en: Since Sarah this morning stuff I keep saying that my hair is perfect.
zh: 从Sarah今天早上开始做造型起，我就一直说我的头发很完美。

en: It is, completely perfect.
zh: 确实，完全完美。

en: No, you are being too nice, you made it look perfect.
zh: 不，你太客气了，是你把它弄得这么完美。

en: I just textured a little bit the hair.
zh: 我只是稍微给头发做了一点纹理。

en: But I like it actually quite messy.
zh: 但我其实挺喜欢它乱一点的感觉。

en: so that's why it has a messy look.
zh: 所以才会有这种随性的凌乱感。

en: If only it was that easy.
zh: 要是真有那么简单就好了。

en: Just put a helmet and take it off.
zh: 戴上头盔，然后摘下来就行。

en: I like having the hair looking natural.
zh: 我喜欢头发看起来很自然。

en: but staying structured the way I place them.
zh: 但又能按照我整理好的样子保持住结构。

en: Which is quite a difficult task.
zh: 这其实是个挺难的任务。

en: c'est super. perfect merci beaucoup.
zh: （这里说的是法语）太棒了。完美，谢谢你。

en: Oh, hello again.
zh: 哦，又见面了。

en: You guys are still here.
zh: 你们还在这儿啊。

en: There's something missing.
zh: 还少了点东西。

en: Can I have the missing part please?
zh: 可以把少的那部分给我吗？

en: Here it is.
zh: 来了。

en: Look at that.
zh: 看看这个。

en: Full Giorgio Armani look.
zh: 整套Giorgio Armani造型。

en: Timeless. It's beautiful.
zh: 经典不过时。真的很美。

en: I love it and I feel good in it.
zh: 我很喜欢，而且穿着感觉很好。

en: Last touch of the golden palm.
zh: 最后再加上金棕榈的小细节。

en: And then we made the fit custom because it's always kind of tricky.
zh: 然后我们把这套衣服做成了定制版，因为这一直有点麻烦。

en: for people that are not so aware about Formula One but we have big necks
zh: 对于不太了解F1的人来说，我们的脖子都比较粗，

en: because this is the muscle that is the toughest when you drive a Formula One car.
zh: 因为开F1赛车时，脖子这块肌肉承受的压力最大。

en: So you always have a problem at the neck with shirts and.
zh: 所以穿衬衫的时候，脖子这里总会有点问题。

en: so we made sure everything was fitting properly.
zh: 所以我们确保所有地方都合身。

en: I will describe my fashion style in minimalist but elevated.
zh: 我会把自己的时尚风格形容为极简，但有质感。

en: And then whatever makes me feel good.
zh: 然后就是穿让我感觉舒服的东西。

en: When I feel good that's where I feel just most myself.
zh: 当我感觉舒服的时候，我就最像我自己。

en: When things just flow and where I feel most authentic.
zh: 一切都很自然流畅，那也是我感觉最真实的时候。

en: What do I do before going to a big event?
zh: 去参加大型活动之前我会做什么？

en: I don't know, just check my hair.
zh: 我也不知道，就是检查一下头发。

en: Making sure that this looks sleek.
zh: 确保它看起来利落。

en: I don't want to have a picture with crazy hair.
zh: 我可不想拍到一张头发乱飞的照片。

en: That's it really.
zh: 真的就这些。

en: And then again, just being myself, smile, enjoy the moment.
zh: 然后还是一样，做自己，微笑，享受当下。

en: I feel like more you get out of your comfort zone.
zh: 我觉得你越是走出舒适区，

en: the most at ease you are with the unexpected.
zh: 就越能从容面对意想不到的事情。

en: Thank you Vanity Fair for getting ready with me.
zh: 谢谢Vanity Fair陪我一起做准备。

en: I'm now ready and I need to go to the premiere.
zh: 我现在准备好了，得去参加首映礼了。

en: Bye bye.
zh: 拜拜。
